en: A vintage black and white postcard depicting a large Byzantine-style church with a central dome, bell tower, and multiple arched windows. The building is situated near the coast, with a sailing ship visible in the background. The postcard includes printed and handwritten text in French and another script, possibly Ottoman Turkish. The church is labeled as 'Eglise-Cathédrale St-Grégoire.' The upper part features the phrase 'Souvenir de Trébizonde.'
